basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 2 Research Associate & Project Fellow Posts

qualification.details: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. | Note: The Degree and experience should be in a relevant field. Candidates will be required to work in both the laboratory and the field.

selection_process: The selection of candidates will be based on a walk-in interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application on a plain paper with a detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained.
Attach attested copies of degree certificates, mark sheets, and experience certificates.
Submit the application to the office of the Principal Investigator through email at [email protected], by post, or produce it directly at the time of the interview.
Attend the walk-in interview on 19 October 2026 at 10:30 A.M. at ICED, IIT Roorkee.
Bring all original degrees, certificates, and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.
important_instructions: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. Applications can be submitted through email, by post, or produced at the time of the interview to the Principal Investigator's office. Candidates must bring original degree/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Candidates will be required to work in both the laboratory and the field.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for the International Centre of Excellence for Dams (ICED).

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Associate / Project Fellow post under project advertisement number ICED-2043-MJS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the candidates will be held on 19 October 2026 at 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICED, IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q5. What are the monthly emoluments for Research Associate?
faq.answer: The emoluments for Research Associate range from Rs. 30,000/- to 75,000/- + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the monthly emoluments for Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments for Project Fellow range from Rs. 40,000/- to 1,000,000/- + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA admissible for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
